data.summary: Hands-on Data Engineering Manager with 14+ years of experience leading and mentoring teams while actively designing and delivering enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions. Strong expertise across Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Big Data, and Python, with a proven ability to balance people leadership and deep technical ownership. Experienced in building scalable BI and data platforms, driving adoption through enablement, and delivering business-aligned analytics in large, complex enterprise environments. Recently involved in agentic AI–based solutions integrated with data platforms to automate analytics workflows and accelerate insight generation.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Engineering Manager
IQVIA | Feb 2022 - Current
Role Summary:
Hands-on Data Engineering Manager leading a team of 25+ data engineers and BI developers while actively contributing to solution design, development, and delivery of cloud-based data and analytics platforms.
Key Responsibilities & Impact:
Lead and mentor a team of 25+ data engineers and BI professionals, balancing people management with hands-on technical ownership.
Design and deliver scalable data pipelines, analytics solutions, and BI platforms using Snowflake, Azure, SQL, Power BI, and Big Data technologies.
Own end-to-end delivery including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, and production support.
Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and performance optimization to ensure high-quality and reliable data solutions.
Partner with business and product stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into scalable, enterprise-ready solutions.
Drive adoption of modern data practices and continuous improvement across platforms and teams.
Lead – Data Engineering & BI
BNP Paribas | ~7 Years
Role Summary:
Hands-on Data Engineering and BI Lead responsible for designing, delivering, and scaling enterprise BI and ETL solutions across Power BI, Tableau, Azure, and Big Data platforms, while acting as a technical SME and mentor.
Key Responsibilities & Impact:
Led end-to-end delivery of Power BI and Tableau analytics solutions across large enterprise datasets, supporting multiple business functions.
Designed and implemented ETL pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF), Big Data technologies, and SQL Server, enabling scalable and reliable data ingestion and transformation.
Played a hands-on technical lead role across data modeling, report design, performance tuning, and production support.
Acted as technology expert (SME) for Power BI, defining best practices, standards, and reusable frameworks.
Trained and mentored 200+ engineers and analysts on Power BI, significantly improving adoption, self-service analytics, and delivery quality across teams.
Collaborated closely with business, product, and leadership stakeholders to translate requirements into robust BI and data solutions.
Environment / Tech Stack:
Power BI, Tableau, Azure, Azure Data Factory, Big Data, SQL Server, ETL, Data Modeling
Earlier Experience
Data Engineer / BI Developer – Multiple Organizations
(Details available on request)
